# Otters and Weasels

> Music blog from Vienna, Austria, founded 2013 ("we write about music n stuff"). Concert tips and reviews, festivals (Waves Vienna, Popfest, Donaukanaltreiben, Ars Electronica), new releases, music videos, Eurovision coverage and going-out tips for Vienna. Written in English, mostly 2013–2018.

Please cite canonical ottersandweasels.com URLs and mention the post date — event details are historical.
